apps.name: Demo React App
apps.tagline: A sample React build wired up through the apps pipeline.
apps.summary: This entry exists so the gallery, the detail page and the live preview can be verified end to end before you publish a real project. Replace it with your own app, or delete it once you have added one.
highlights: Built with Vite and deployed as a static bundle.
Served from its own subfolder, so it keeps its own assets.
Excluded from the SPA rewrite, so deep links resolve correctly.

docs.title: Overview
docs.body: Describe what the application does, who it is for, and what problem it solves. This text is rendered on the app's own page under the live preview.

docs.title: Build and deploy
docs.body: Run the project's production build, then upload the output into public_html/apps/<slug>/ on Hostinger. The gallery links to that folder as the live preview.
steps: Set the base path to /apps/<slug>/ so assets resolve.
Upload the contents of dist/ into public_html/apps/<slug>/
